items.title: Sapienz Receives ISSTA 2026 Impact Paper Award
items.summary: Ke Mao, Mark Harman, and Yue Jia have been recognized with the ACM SIGSOFT International Symposium on Software Testing and Analysis (ISSTA) 2026 Most Influential Paper Award for their 2016 research, “Sapienz: multi-objective automated testing for Android applications.” The recognition celebrates a decade of impact from work that began at University College London and went [...]Read More...The post Sapienz Receives ISSTA 2026 Impact Paper Award appeared first on Engineering at Meta.
